history.summary: Privatised EC 2BR in Punggol at $1,610 PSF — meaningfully above the ~$1,449 PSF recent transacted average for the project, leaving little upside headroom on entry. Good liquidity (373 units, deep D19 HDB-upgrader pool) but the entry price is rich.
history.rating_rationale: 807sqft 2BR at $1.30M / $1,610 PSF vs project recent average ~$1,449 PSF (range $1,280-$1,581) — listing is at/above the top of the recent band, so it is not a value entry. 2015-built privatised EC, Coral Edge LRT 380m only (no MRT, one LRT stop from Punggol). Score 619 / Elo 1056 with a losing 175-239 record. No URA project rate available. Punggol Digital District + CRL are real long-term catalysts but already broadly priced into D19 EC values.
red_flags: Listed ~10%+ above recent project transacted average PSF
Only LRT (380m), no direct MRT within walking distance
EC product caps prestige upside vs true private condo

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: 2BR has the widest tenant pool and Punggol attracts young families/PDD workers, but EC rents in Punggol are modest; yield ordinary.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Privatised EC appreciation already largely realised; entering above recent average PSF limits further upside over a 5-7yr hold.
